meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 写前端界面时,Claude 会先输出 <design_plan>,用模拟 Python 随机挑选 Hero 布局、字体、组件与 GSAP 动画,再生成遵循 AIDA 结构、不留空格子、带滚动动画的页面代码。
howto.when: 当你要求它设计或用 React/Tailwind 构建网页界面时,它会接管流程,先做随机抽选再写代码,并禁用 Inter 字体与 “SECTION 01” 这类标签。

say.text: 做一个无空隙的 bento 网格,用 grid-flow-dense
给这个页面加上 GSAP 滚动固定和 scrubbing 文字揭示

howto.what_en: For front-end UI, Claude first outputs a <design_plan>: simulated Python randomization picks the Hero layout, fonts, components and GSAP animations. Then it writes AIDA-structured code with gapless bento grids and GSAP scroll motion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to design or build web UI with React/Tailwind; it randomizes layouts first and bans Inter along with labels like "SECTION 01".

say_en.text: Build an Awwwards-style landing page with Python-randomized Hero layout.
Make a gapless bento grid using grid-flow-dense.
Add GSAP scroll pinning and scrubbing text reveals to this page.
